info.description: What Meridian knows about an organisation's projects, twins, readings, alerts, issues and audit log, for other systems. See docs/manual/15-the-api.md. Every answer has its content under `data`. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC, except readings, which use Unix milliseconds.
